candidate: A2: soft-stylized silhouette sample (hand-built from primitives)
edits: Every vertex is generated by tools/blender/character/build_commuter_soft.py from rings, eggs and lofted strips: no body generator (MakeHuman/MPFB/HumGen) and no downloaded mesh is involved

38-joint UE-style contract armature reused from the candidate A build (tools/blender/character/build_commuter_mpfb.py build_armature); joint layout starts from the p0 sample and moves the shoulders to 0.394 m span, the head pivot to 1.53 m and the arms to hang at the sides

Proportions 6.20 heads (height 1.680 m over a chin-to-crown head of 0.271 m, hair excluded; the bob reaches 1.680 m); coat hem 0.50 m above the floor; 3630 triangles over two primitives (VIS_body 2398, VIS_head 1232)

Coat body and sleeves are 16-sided lofts with smooth shared normals in the glb; the coat's top rings taper into the neckline instead of closing with a flat cap, and the sleeve's dome tops out level with the coat's shoulder slope so the shoulder reads round with no corner at the torso

Open coat front: two navy lapels fold proud along a soft V from the collar to mid-chest (1.386 m down to 1.19 m) and the cream knit #e8dcc4 is a curved patch inside the V with a rounded crew-neck arc at its top edge, replacing the earlier flat cream triangle
Face: thin brow decals (4.4 mm tall) and eyes 15 percent larger than round 1 (16.1 x 8.0 x 23.0 mm ellipsoids); the blink shape keys are unchanged

Head: scaled to the 6.2-head ratio, with a bob that hugs the skull by 1.5 cm, keeps its silhouette below the temples and flares to a level hem at the jawline, covers the nape to the collar and carries a side-swept fringe
Neck shortened by a stand collar (1.352-1.396 m) that emerges through the coat's neckline, with a 0.052 m neck radius, so almost no neck shows between the collar and the jaw

Limbs: sleeves 0.056 m at the shoulder tapering to 0.040 m at the wrist with a rounded shoulder cap in place of shoulder-pad geometry; straight trousers 0.068 m at the coat hem tapering to 0.050 m at the ankle; coat fuller at the hip with a gentle A-line hem, flared 2 cm wider than round 2 (hem half-axes 0.225 x 0.150 m) so the stride has more room inside the skirt
Feet: low loafer built from oval rings, 24 cm long, 7 cm high, standing on z = 0

Weights: spine chain by height with two-bone blends, rigid limbs with two-bone blends at elbows, knees, shoulders and hips, coat skirt panels as described below (no vertex mixes both thighs), tote bag on the pelvis and its strap blending pelvis to spine_03; normalised, top 4 influences
Flat vertex colours, no textures: #26324b coat and lapels, #e8dcc4 knit layer, #a8a59a trousers, #2a2622 shoes, #cfa283 skin, #3b2a20 bob hair and brows, #2a2320 eyes, #9a5a4a mouth, #8a7a66 tote
VIS_head shape keys Basis, blinkLeft, blinkRight; each blink flattens its own eye ellipsoid to 10 percent of its height about the eye centre (52 vertices per eye)

Clips idle (4.0 s), walk (1.0 s), run (0.6 s) at 30 fps reused from the candidate A build: planar two-link leg IK, flat feet in stance, pelvis bob, arms adducted with opposite swing; this build lowers the walk crouch from 0.075 m to 0.025 m so the stance leg stays near straight

Coat skirt split below 0.86 m into left/right panels (front opening + back vent, 3 deg lap at each seam); each panel eases from pelvis 1.0 at the hip line to pelvis 0.1 / same-side thigh 0.9 at the hem, so the stride shows trousers only through the vent or the front opening
